values.note: Chippewa County: $20 a night, plus $7 for 20/30/50-amp electric (optional, at every site); a dock slip is $5 a night more. $7 reservation fee per reservation; the seventh night of a reservation is free. Up to six adults a site. Dump station $2 for campers.

note: Chippewa County park on Long Lake, a clear 936-acre lake with a boat launch, swim beach and five shared docks. Site 9 alone has its own dock on the shore; the other sites sit back across the picnic area or the beach. Site 28 is hard to back a longer rig into. --Claude
summary: County page, terms PDF, 27 per-site pages and map read: $20 + $7 electric (50A at every site), $7 reservation fee; reservations May to mid-Sept, 10 days ahead, THREE-NIGHT MINIMUM per reservation (caretaker sells unreserved sites nightly, first come); season May 1 - Oct 31; flush toilets, dump, water. Lakefront -> lakeview: only site 9 touches the shore. Pin is the boat launch, ~150 m from the loop (no move).
flags: DROP CANDIDATE? STANDING MINIMUM: the county terms (me_terms_4-9-25.pdf, linked from the current page) say 'All reservations must be made a minimum of 10 days prior to park arrival date - three-night minimum, fourteen-night maximum per reservation'. It covers every reservation all season. Against it: 'Unreserved sites are sold by the park caretaker, first come, first served on the night you want to camp', and mid-Sept to Oct is self-registration only - so a one-night stay is possible, but only as a walk-up. The campground page itself does not repeat the minimum. Reviewer's call; written as min_stay 3 always.

WATERFRONT: stored lakefront (--Claude, not --AWH) -> lakeview. Only site 9 is on the shore ('the only campsite with a private dock attached to the site. It is right next to the beach'; map position ~45.2538,-91.4144, under canopy - not confirmed on imagery). Sites 2-7 are 'across the picnic area from the shared boat docks' and 8 and 10 'across from the beach' (the swim beach and picnic area are day use between them and the water); the west and interior-loop sites (11-28) are farther back under continuous canopy. One nightly-sold site with its own dock is a lakefront lead for the reviewer, not enough on its own to keep the value.
PIN: stored 45.2545,-91.4121 is the boat launch at the east end; the loop centre is ~45.2541,-91.4140, ~150 m west - under 250 m, no move proposed.
SITES: stored 28 (note prose) -> 27 (booking site lists sites 2-28; no site 1). Pads 34-64 ft deep; all fit a 23-ft rig on paper, but site 28 is described as 'very hard to get a longer rig into'.
FEES: stored $27 flat -> $20-27 (electric is optional); reservation fee $7 per reservation added.
